questions.question: The following bar chart represents the birth rate (per thousand) of six different countries. Study the bar chart and answer the question given below: The birth rate of country E is what per cent of the birth rate of the Country A?
questions.questionHtml:
The following bar chart represents the birth rate (per thousand) of six different countries. Study the bar chart and answer the question given below:

The birth rate of country E is what per cent of the birth rate of the Country A?
questions.solution:
From the Bar Graph

⇒ Birth rate of country A = 20/thousand

⇒ Birth rate of country E = 36/thousand

⇒ Percentage = (birth rate of country E)/(birth rate of country A) × 100 

⇒ Percentage = (36/20) × 100 = 180%

∴ The Birth rate of country E is 180% of birth rate of country A

questions.question: The following graph shows the number of boys and girls in class V, class VI, class VII and class VIII. Study the graph and answer the question. What is the average number of girls in all the classes?
questions.questionHtml:

What is the average number of girls in all the classes?
questions.solution:
Given:

Girls in class V = 58

Girls in class VI = 57

Girls in class VII = 62

Girls in class VIII = 59

Concept Used:

Average = Total number of girls/Number of classes

Calculations:

Total number of girls in all classes = (58 + 57 + 62 + 59)

⇒ Total number of girls in all classes = 236

Number of classes = 4

Average = Total number of girls/Number of classes

⇒ Average = 236/4

⇒ Average = 59

∴ The average number of girls in all the classes is 59.

questions.solution:
Calculations :

Marks of E in Maths = 60

Marks of E in English = 50

Marks of E in Physics = 70 

Total marks of E = 60 + 50 + 70 = 180

Percentage marks of E = (Marks obtained/Total marks) × 100

⇒ (180/300) × 100

⇒ 60

∴ The Correct choice will be option 4.

Alternate MethodSince the maximum marks is 100. We can say marks obtained is the percentage obtained.

Average percentage is 60% as 50, 60 and 70 are in A.P and the number of terms is odd. Then the average will be the middle term which is 60.

∴ The average is 60%.

questions.question: The given graph represents the rainfall (in cm) in a city, over a period of six years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. In which two consecutive years was the difference of the rainfall minimum?
questions.questionHtml:
The given graph represents the rainfall (in cm) in a city, over a period of six years. Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

In which two consecutive years was the difference of the rainfall minimum?
questions.solution:
Given :-

In year 2005 rainfall = 40 cm

In year 2006 rainfall = 50 cm

In year 2007 rainfall = 100 cm

In year 2008 rainfall = 80 cm     

In year 2009 rainfall = 20 cm

In year 2010 rainfall = 120 cm

Calculation :- 

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2005 and 2006 = 50 - 40 = 10 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2006 and 2007 = 100 - 50 = 50 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2007 and 2008 = 100 - 80 = 20 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2008 and 2009 = 80 - 20 = 60 cm

⇒ Difference of rainfall in 2009 and 2010 = 120 - 20 = 100 cm

⇒ The difference of the rainfall minimum = 10 cm 

⇒ The two consecutive years = 2005 - 2006

∴ The two consecutive years the difference of the rainfall minimum is 2005 - 2006

questions.question: Study the following graph and answer the question based on the graph. What was the percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday?
questions.questionHtml:
Study the following graph and answer the question based on the graph.

What was the percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday?
questions.solution:
Given:

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

Formula Used:

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

Calculations:

Units produced on Friday = 50

Units produced on Friday = 30

Percentage Decline = ((a – b)/a) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = ((50 – 30)/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = (20/50) × 100

⇒ Percentage Decline = 40%

∴ The percentage decline in the production from Friday to Saturday is 40%.

questions.questionHtml:

The expenditure from 2001 to 2002 is decreased by what percentage?
questions.solution:
Formula Used:

Percentage decrease = (x1 -  x2)/x1 × 100

x1 → Original number 

x2 → New number 

Calculation:

Expenditure in 2001 = 20 lakhs

Expenditure in 2002 = 15 lakhs

Decrement = 20 - 15 = 5 lakhs

∴ Required percentage = (5/20) × 100 = 25%

questions.questionHtml: In the given bar – chart, the ratio of total sales of branches B1, B3 and B5 to total sales of branches B2, B4 and B6 taken together for both the years (in thousand numbers) is∶
questions.solution:
Sale of books for branch B1 in 2000 and 2001 = 80 + 105 = 185

Sale of books for branch B3 in 2000 and 2001 = 95 + 110 = 205

Sale of books for branch B5 in 2000 and 2001 = 75 + 95 = 170

⇒ Total sale of books for branches B1, B3 and B5 taken together for both 2000 and 2001 = 185 + 205 + 170 = 560

Sale of books for branch B2 in 2000 and 2001 = 75 + 65 = 140

Sale of books for branch B4 in 2000 and 2001 = 85 + 95 = 180

Sale of books for branch B6 in 2000 and 2001 = 70 + 80 = 150

⇒ Total sale of books for branches B2, B4 and B6 taken together for both 2000 and 2001 = 140 + 180 + 150 = 470

∴ Ratio of total sales of branches B1, B3 and B5 to total sales of branches B2, B4 and B6 taken together for both the years = 560/470 = 56 ∶ 47
